About Index Exchange:
Index Exchange is a global advertising supply-side platform enabling media owners to maximize the value of their content on any screen. As a trusted partner and ally, we connect leading experience makers with the world’s largest brands to ensure a quality experience for consumers.

We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. With our radically transparent business practices and dedication to total market efficiency, we’re committed to upholding the integrity of the programmatic ecosystem at large.

What’s it like to work at Index?
Index is an exciting and fast-paced place to work. You'll be able to feed your ambition, lean into trust and transparency, and feel genuine support from your colleagues. We’re built on our core values and live them each day. They're‌ not just buzzwords.

We pride ourselves on our independence and openness, not only in our technology, but in our teams, too. Our diverse and inclusive culture celebrates how we can leverage our unique differences to help drive Index forward.

We have more than 550 Indexers around the globe dedicated to building a safe and transparent marketplace that provides a trusted experience for consumers, and we’re looking for talented professionals to help take us to the next level.

Are you ready to join the programmatic evolution?
The Workplace Concierge and Experience Coordinatorrole ensures that our Torontooffice runs smoothly, efficiently, and up to Index standards. This role delivers an exceptional experience for everyone who walks through our doors —from clients and candidates to fellow Indexers.

As the heartbeat of a well-functioning office, this person brings adaptability, attention to detail, and a strong service mindset to everything they do.

What we’re looking for:
  • Adaptable: Thrive in organizations that constantly evolve and adapt
  • Independent: Comfort with ambiguity and self-starter with an aptitude for defining new processes
  • Problem solver: Experience working with teams and collaborating across groups to achieve desired results.
  • Collaborator: Work closely with theGlobalWorkplace team and other Index departments such as IT & People Ops, Community
  • Detail oriented: High attention to detail, ensuring quality and accuracy of work
  • Willingness to learn: Welcome continual feedback andseekto learn on an ongoing basis
  • Creativity: Creative thinker and ability to build out creative content
  • Passionate: Curious and love experimenting with different approaches to find the most efficient solution to a problem

Here’s what you’ll be doing:
Office Experience
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Indexers, visitors, candidates, and guests, ensuring a seamless, welcoming, and high-quality experience at every interaction.
  • Act as a steward of company culture, helping foster a positive and engaging office environment
  • Coordinate office lunch programs (e.g., weekly Thursday lunches), including vendor coordination, ordering, delivery, office communications and setup
  • Maintain café and tea points, ensuring consistent stocking, cleanliness, and presentation standards
  • Partner with Community to support onsite events, activations, and employee engagement initiatives
  • Serve as a liaison between the Workplace team and local employees to ensure needs are met
  • Collaborate with IT, People Ops, and Community to support onboarding and offboarding processes, including workstation setup, equipment coordination, office access, and
  • delivering a smooth first-day experience, while ensuring an easy and efficient equipment return process for offboarding employees.

Workplace Operations & Vendor Management
  • Assist with daily office operations to ensure a clean, organized, and fully functional workspace
  • Coordinate the ordering and restocking of office supplies, pantry items, and workplace equipment, ensuring all purchases align with team guidelines and approval processes.
  • Coordinate with vendors and building management for services such as cleaning, maintenance, repairs, and deliveries
  • Ensure all vendors comply with building policies and requirements
  • Handle incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely distribution and organization
  • Maintain common areas, conference rooms, kitchens, and restrooms to high standards
  • Proactively monitor office operations, resolve day-to-day issues, and escalate to the Workplace Manager to ensure smooth, uninterrupted workplace operations.
  • Support office safety and compliance, including emergency procedures and coordination of drills
  • Partner with the global Workplace team to keep documents organized—handling scanning, filing, and maintaining accurate, up-to-date records.
  • Respond to and manage requests submitted via Jira, providing backup support as needed
  • Assist with outgoing shipments and returns via FedEx, including label creation, scheduling pickups, tracking deliveries, and ensuring cost-effective shipping practices.
  • Act as the Workplace team admin, managing weekly global meeting agendas and Fun
  • Friday coordination, while tracking employee milestones and partnering with Workplace Managers to deliver thoughtful

Meetings & Event Logistics
  • Assist with planning and executing internal events and onsite meetings, including room set-ups, catering, and visitor access.
  • Support and manage conference room scheduling, resolving conflicts as needed
  • Partner with internal teams (Workplace, IT, Community) to deliver seamless meeting and event experiences
  • Assist 

Here's what you need:
Skills and Requirements
  • Commitment to training and skills development – you already have or willing to obtain specialized training related to the job such as Heights (ladder safety), Lean Six Sigma, St. John Ambulance or local equivalent
  • Strong communication skills: verbal, written and listening
  • Proficiency in Confluence, Adobe Cloud, Canva, Microsoft Office Suite, Jira
  • Attention to detail, ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize
  • 2-4 years of related work experience

Physical Requirements
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and use their hands to handle or feel objects, as well as speak and hear clearly.
  • The employee may occasionally need to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Flexibility in schedule is required, including the ability to adjust working hours to support business needs.
  • Monday to Friday : 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

Salary: The base salary range for this role is $58,000 to $68,000 CAD. The total compensation package may vary depending on non-discriminatory factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 

Why you’ll love working here:
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents 
  • Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules 
  • Competitive retirement matching plans 
  • Equity packages 
  • Generous parental leave available to birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive parents 
  • Annual well-being allowance plus fitness discounts and group wellness activities  
  • Employee assistance program 
  • Mental health first aid program that provides an in-the-moment point of contact and reassurance 
  • One day of volunteer time off per year and a donation-matching program 
  • Monthly town halls and regular community-led team events 
  • Multiple resources and programming to support continuous learning
  • A workplace that supports a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment – learn more here 

Equal employment opportunity
At Index Exchange, we believe that successful products are built by teams just as diverse as the audience who uses them. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunities. We celebrate diversity of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Additionally, we realize that diversity is deeper than any status or classification—diversity is the human experience. For those who show grit, passion, and humility—Index will welcome you.

Accessibility for applicants with disabilities
Index Exchange welcomes and encourages individuals with disabilities to apply to work with us. 

If you require an accommodation, please share the details of your request and any information how we can assist you with the hiring recruiter when they contact you. Index Exchange will make reasonable efforts to ensure accommodation requests are met throughout the recruitment process.

Index everywhere, Index anywhere
Our corporate headquarters are in Toronto, with major offices in New York, Montreal, Kitchener, London, San Francisco, and many other global cities. As a major global advertising exchange, we are committed to operating as a tightly knit global team and embracing and empowering talent wherever our colleagues may be. 

AI Disclaimer: Automated tools including artificial intelligence may be used to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this role. All hiring decisions involve human review. 
 
Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.
